previous_notes.text: Patient presented with a PSA of 2.1 ng/mL. Digital rectal examination was unremarkable. Given the normal PSA and DRE, no further urological investigation was initiated at this time. Routine follow-up was arranged.

pathology_report:
Biopsy timepoint 1: Prostate needle biopsy specimens were received. Histological examination reveals benign prostatic tissue. No malignant glands are identified. The Gleason score is 0+0, corresponding to ISUP grade group 0. No cribriform or intraductal patterns are identified. Perineural invasion is absent. The sampling was taken from the mid left region. 

Overall trajectory: The histological findings have remained stable across the single available biopsy timepoint, with no evidence of malignancy.
